name: paper-reader
description: A VS Code research paper reader with PDF viewing, Codex context actions, MinerU extraction, and AI translation.

commands.title: Paper Reader: Test Send Selection to Codex
Paper Reader: Send Selection to Codex

paper-reader.default.cursor.markdownDescription: The default cursor tool for preview.

paper-reader.default.scale.markdownDescription: The default zoom level for preview. Allowed values are `auto`, `page-actual`, `page-fit`, `page-width`, and 1-based scale values. (`1.0` means 100%)

paper-reader.default.sidebar.markdownDescription: Show the sidebar on load. The default visibility of sidebar for preview.

paper-reader.default.scrollMode.markdownDescription: The default scroll mode for preview.

paper-reader.default.spreadMode.markdownDescription: The default spread mode for preview.

paper-reader.ai.apiKey.markdownDescription: OpenAI-compatible API key for full PDF translation. You can also set `PAPER_READER_AI_API_KEY` or `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`.

paper-reader.ai.baseUrl.markdownDescription: OpenAI-compatible API base URL for full PDF translation.

paper-reader.ai.model.markdownDescription: OpenAI-compatible model for full PDF translation.

paper-reader.ai.translationPrompt.markdownDescription: System prompt used for full PDF translation.
paper-reader.ai.translationPrompt.default:
你是科研论文 Markdown 正文翻译引擎。
你会收到 JSON 数组，每个对象格式为 {"id":"S0","text":"英文正文"}。
请把每个 text 的英文学术正文准确翻译成中文。
必须返回合法 JSON 数组，格式为 [{"id":"S0","translation":"译文"}]。
每个输入 id 必须且只能在输出中出现一次，不要遗漏、合并或新增 id。
必须原样保留所有 {{PAPER_READER_INLINE_KEEP_0}} 和 {{PAPER_READER_KEEP_BLOCK_0}} 形式的占位符。
必须保留公式、变量名、引用编号、人名、机构名、专有名词、缩写和数字。
不要翻译占位符，不要添加解释，不要输出 Markdown 代码块，只输出 JSON 数组。

paper-reader.ai.translationConcurrency.markdownDescription: Maximum concurrent AI requests for full PDF translation. Increase for speed; lower it if other Paper Reader actions feel delayed while translating.

paper-reader.selectionTranslation.apiKey.markdownDescription: Optional OpenAI-compatible API key for PDF selection translation. Leave empty to inherit Paper Reader AI API key. You can also set `PAPER_READER_SELECTION_AI_API_KEY`.

paper-reader.selectionTranslation.baseUr.markdownDescription: Optional OpenAI-compatible API base URL for PDF selection translation. Leave empty to inherit Paper Reader AI base URL.

paper-reader.selectionTranslation.model.markdownDescription: Optional model for PDF selection translation. Leave empty to inherit Paper Reader AI model.

paper-reader.selectionTranslation.prompt.markdownDescription: System prompt used for PDF selection translation.
paper-reader.selectionTranslation.prompt.default: 你是科研论文阅读助手。请把用户选中的英文学术论文片段准确翻译成中文。保留公式、变量、引用编号、人名、机构名、专有名词和缩写；不要添加解释；只输出译文。

paper-reader.output.directory.markdownDescription: Directory for generated translations, notes, and PDF annotations. Relative paths are resolved from the current workspace root.

paper-reader.markdown.editMode.markdownDescription: Default edit mode for the Paper Reader Markdown editor. `wysiwyg` is closest to Typora; `ir` keeps more Markdown source markers visible.

paper-reader.markdown.editorTheme.markdownDescription: Theme for the Paper Reader Markdown editor.

paper-reader.markdown.codeMirrorTheme.markdownDescription: Code block theme for the Paper Reader Markdown editor.

paper-reader.markdown.mermaidTheme.markdownDescription: Mermaid diagram theme for the Paper Reader Markdown editor.

paper-reader.mineru.executable.markdownDescription: MinerU CLI executable path. Use `mineru` when it is available on PATH.

paper-reader.mineru.effort.markdownDescription: MinerU Hybrid parsing effort. `high` enables higher-accuracy parsing with image/chart analysis support and may take longer. Applies to `hybrid-*` backends.

paper-reader.mineru.modelSource.markdownDescription: MinerU model source. Use `local` after pre-downloading models with `mineru-models-download`; use `auto` to let MinerU choose.

paper-reader.mineru.proxyUrl.markdownDescription: Proxy URL used by MinerU local backends while downloading model files. Clear this field to disable Paper Reader's MinerU download proxy override.

paper-reader.mineru.apiUrl.markdownDescription: Optional MinerU FastAPI base URL. Leave empty to let MinerU CLI start a temporary local service.

paper-reader.mineru.lang.markdownDescription: Optional MinerU OCR language hint. This can improve OCR accuracy, mainly for pipeline backend.

paper-reader.mineru.formula.markdownDescription: Enable MinerU formula parsing. This can require substantially more memory on Windows.

paper-reader.mineru.imageAnalysis.markdownDescription: Enable MinerU image/chart analysis for VLM and hybrid backends. Hybrid medium effort disables image/chart analysis.

paper-reader.mineru.device.markdownDescription: MinerU compute device preference. `cuda` sets `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES`; `cpu` disables CUDA for the MinerU process.

paper-reader.mineru.cudaDevice.markdownDescription: CUDA device id used when MinerU device is `cuda`.

paper-reader.mineru.renderThreads.markdownDescription: MinerU PDF render thread count. Lower values reduce peak memory usage.

paper-reader.mineru.processingWindowSize.markdownDescription: MinerU processing window size. Lower values reduce peak memory usage.

paper-reader.mineru.fallbackToPdfJs.markdownDescription: Fall back to the built-in PDF.js text extractor when MinerU is unavailable or fails.
